I used film-crew to plan the shots, then seedance-25-director to write the prompt.

The teaser is called "From the page to the screen." A line of ink becomes a script, then a film set, then a performance, then a wall of episodes, and it ends on the handwritten signature. It's one 30-second Seedance 2.5 call with 6 shots of 5 seconds each. The look borrows Fincher's controlled, precise style (the library card for it hasn't been checked against sources yet), recoloured in black, white and graphite. Red #D90429 appears only once: the triangle on the "i" in the last shot.

**Assumptions:**
- There are no actor or footage references, so the actress is described in words only.
- "48 projects" and "2,300+ episodes" are added as text in the edit, because AI-generated numbers aren't reliable.
- Seedance makes only the sound effects. Add music in the edit.
- The logo comes from `.claude/skills/director-desk/assets/maghakian_logo_light.png`.

**Session notes:**
- This folder isn't a git repo and had no NOTES.md, so I couldn't pull or push.
- I created `NOTES.md` with today's entry.
- The full plan is in `film-crew/maghakian-reels-teaser/plan.md`.
- I couldn't run the film-crew checking script (no shell in this session). I checked the plan by hand instead.

**Shot plan**
| # | Time | Shot | What happens | Sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–5 s | Extreme close-up, top-down | A pen nib writes one line of handwriting, then lifts out of frame | Nib scratch, lamp hum |
| 2 | 5–10 s | Top-down, camera rises | A script lands on the table; the camera rises to show a grid of about 48 black scripts | Thud, paper |
| 3 | 10–15 s | Close-up to wide | A blank clapperboard snaps, with a white flash; the camera dollies into a hazy soundstage | Clap, camera whir |
| 4 | 15–20 s | Close-up | The actress lifts her eyes; the camera pushes in 10 cm and stops when she stops | Room tone |
| 5 | 20–25 s | Close-up on a monitor, then a wall of screens | Her face is now on one monitor; the camera pulls back to show a wall of hundreds of screens | Rising monitor hum |
| 6 | 25–30 s | Locked frame on black | The screens go off; the signature writes itself; the red triangle drops onto the "i" | Silence, pen strokes, one tick |

**Risks:**
- The model may not reproduce the signature exactly. The fallbacks are below.
- The grid won't be exactly 48 scripts.
- Look out for stray text on the screens or stray red. If either appears, generate again.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina → AI Video → Seedance 2.5)**
- Mode: Omni Reference
- Duration: 30 s
- Ratio: 9:16
- Resolution: 720p (use a higher one if the interface offers it)
- Upload one file: **@Image 1** = `maghakian_logo_light.png`. If its background is transparent, export it on solid black #000000 first.

**Prompt**
```text
30-second cinematic brand teaser for a screenwriting and film production studio, six shots with clean cuts, vertical frame: one handwritten line of ink grows into a stack of scripts, a film set, a performance and a wall of screens, and ends on the studio's handwritten signature logo. Strict black, white and graphite monochrome with a single red accent at the very end.

[Reference layer]
@Image 1 is the studio logo: the handwritten signature word "Maghakian" in white ink, the word "scripts" small beneath it, and a small red triangle as the dot of the letter i. Use @Image 1 only in the final shot (25-30s). Reproduce its letterforms, proportions, stroke weight and the red triangle exactly; take nothing else from it. The logo must not appear anywhere before 25s.

[Global settings]
Base environment & texture: night; a writer's room, a film soundstage and a dark editing room; extreme real physical texture: paper fibre, wet ink sheen, matte metal, haze inside light beams, glass of monitor screens.
Visual style: cinematic realism, clean digital image, controlled shallow depth of field, low-key practical lighting with a single hard key light, slightly underexposed. Near-monochrome grade: deep black #000000 shadows, graphite #111111 midtones, clean white highlights. The only saturated colour in the entire video is red #D90429, and it appears only once: the red triangle of the logo in the final shot.
Camera language: precise, motivated moves only; locked-off frames or perfectly smooth dolly and crane moves that start and stop exactly with the action; no handheld shake; vertical compositions with the main subject centred in the middle third of the frame.
Character styling (15-25s only): an Armenian woman about 30, warm olive skin retaining real fine pores and skin texture, defined brow bone, straight nose, full lips, strong jaw, dark calm eyes holding a quiet decision, dark brown hair pulled back tightly with a few loose strands at the temple, plain black cotton crew-neck top, slim build, still and composed.
Performance core: every image is controlled and deliberate; each shot does one thing and ends in a still, readable frame; the feeling is quiet confidence, the craft of work rather than spectacle.
Prohibited: no background music, no voice-over, no dialogue, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text or numbers before 25s, no readable words on paper, script covers, clapperboard or screens, no brand names, no watermarks, no red anywhere before 25s (no red lights, red clothing, red objects or red tint), no colour other than black, white, grey and the single red triangle, no extra people in the close-ups, no handheld wobble, no morphing of objects between shots, the actress's face does not change between 15s and 25s.

[Timestamped storyboard]
[0-5s] The first line
Physical directives: extreme close-up, top-down, on a sheet of white paper on a graphite desk, a single desk lamp as key light from frame-left. A black fountain pen nib writes one fluid line of handwriting from left to right (flowing letter shapes, not readable), wet black ink glistening behind it. At 4s the nib lifts and exits the top of the frame; the wet line stays. Locked camera with a very slow push-in that matches the pen's travel and stops when the pen lifts. Sound: crisp nib scratch on paper, faint lamp hum.
Emotion / camera intent: every story begins on the page.

[5-10s] The body of work
Physical directives: hard cut. Top-down on the same graphite table, same key light from frame-left. A hand drops a thick bound screenplay with a blank black cover onto the table with a dull thud and withdraws. The camera cranes straight up, smoothly, revealing that this script is one of many identical blank black bound scripts laid in a precise grid that fills the table. At 9s the crane stops; the grid holds still.
Emotion / camera intent: years of writing, dozens of projects, order and discipline.

[10-15s] Production
Physical directives: a blank black clapperboard fills the centre of the frame right at the lens and snaps shut with a sharp clap; the screen bursts into white light for an instant, then the clapperboard drops out of frame downward, revealing a dark soundstage: a cinema camera on a dolly in the foreground, two crew members as dark silhouettes, one hard white backlight beam cutting through haze. The camera dollies slowly forward toward the lit area at the centre and stops at 14.5s. Sound: the clap, soft camera motor whir, distant stage room tone.
Emotion / camera intent: the page becomes production.

[15-20s] The performance
Physical directives: natural shot switch to a close-up of the actress standing in that lit set, hard white side key light from frame-left, black void behind her. She raises her eyes from the floor to a point just off the lens and holds, one slow breath through the nose, a slight tightening of the jaw. The camera pushes in about 10 cm exactly as her eyes rise and stops the instant they stop. Sound: quiet room tone, her single breath.
Emotion / camera intent: the written character becomes a living person.

[20-25s] The episodes
Physical directives: zoom-out transition: her same close-up shrinks and is revealed to be playing on one monitor in a dark editing room. The camera dollies straight back, smoothly, revealing that this monitor is one of a vast wall of hundreds of glowing monitors, each playing a different black-and-white scene (faces, interiors, streets, crowds), no readable text on any screen. At 24.5s the full wall fills the frame and the camera stops. Sound: a low electronic hum of many monitors, slowly swelling.
Emotion / camera intent: one story multiplied into thousands of episodes.

[25-30s] The signature
Physical directives: at 25s every screen switches off at once and the frame becomes pure black #000000; the hum cuts to total silence. From 25.5s to 28s the handwritten signature "Maghakian" from @Image 1 writes itself in white ink in the centre of the frame, stroke by stroke from left to right, as if by an invisible pen; the small word "scripts" fades in beneath it. At 28.5s the small red #D90429 triangle drops into place as the dot of the letter i with one soft tick. 28.5-30s: hold perfectly still on the complete logo on pure black. Locked frontal camera. Sound: faint pen strokes during the writing, the single tick, then silence.
Emotion / camera intent: everything returns to the author's signature.

[Global supplement]
Vertical frame throughout, main subjects centred in the middle third. Low-key light with one hard key, monochrome black, white and graphite; red #D90429 appears only on the logo triangle after 28s. Diegetic sound effects only. Pure video, no subtitles, no background music.
```
